body.name: P_sel
body.sig: \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1),\qquad P_{\eta}^{(k)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1,\text{ regime }k),\quad k\in[K]\)
body.def: The observational selected law is defined separately by \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}:=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\); this is the only selected law when \(K=0\) and it contains no intervention index or indicator. For \(K\ge 1\) and each \(k\in[K]\), \(P_{\eta}^{(k)}:=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1,\text{ regime }k)\) is the selected intervention-arm law.
